message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
    - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
    - main

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build and test repo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - cc: gcc
            cxx: g++
          - cc: clang
            cxx: clang++
          - cc: clang
            cxx: clang++
            cxxflags: -fsanitize=address -g
    env:
      CC: ${{ matrix.cc }}
      CXX: ${{ matrix.cxx }}
      CXXFLAGS: ${{ matrix.cxxflags }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Cache APT packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: /var/cache/apt/archives
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-apt-${{ hashFiles('.github/workflows/ci.yml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-apt-
      - run: sudo apt-get update
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: >
          sudo apt-get install
          pkg-config
          libsystemd-dev
          libjsoncpp-dev
          googletest
          meson
          g++
      - run: meson build/
      - run: ninja -C build/
      - run: ninja -C build/ test",
  "rationale": "The job repeatedly runs `apt-get update` plus `apt-get install` for the same system dependencies in every matrix cell with no cache, which is repeated dependency fetching. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE evidence (dependency-download caching for pip/Go/Gradle with measured savings and preserved checks) supports adding an actions/cache step for the APT archives. Checkout is moved ahead of apt so the cache key can hash the workflow file (the dependency manifest) together with the runner OS; restore keys provide fallback hits. The build matrix, compiler/sanitizer coverage, meson/ninja build, and test steps are unchanged. No secrets, privileged actions, deployment/publishing, or new network targets are introduced (actions/cache is the same official publisher as the already-used actions/checkout).",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200"]
}
